lines.line: If countries were stocks, which one would you buy?
Then came oil, and the Gulf rockets.
Oil boom: Saudi Arabia hits twenty eight thousand dollars in 1981. Bust: nine thousand by 1988.
In 1987, Israel passes Saudi Arabia again, and stays above it every year since.
In 1960, an Israeli made nine times what an Egyptian made. Today, almost twenty times.
Now take out the oil and gas.
Iraq loses over forty percent. Saudi Arabia and Qatar, about a quarter. Israel, under half a percent.
Qatar and Israel end up neck and neck.
Empires got rich by taking. Oil states, by drilling.
Israel, like Singapore and Korea, had no oil. It had people.
Drip irrigation, Waze, Mobileye, Iron Dome. Tech is now fifty eight percent of exports.
Something from nothing. Israel had no oil. It invested in people. Invest in Israel.
